+    def test_kinit_executable_with_spaces_and_unique_caches(self, monkeypatch, tmpdir):
+        executable = tmpdir.join('custom kinit')
+        executable.write('')
+
+        mock_popen = MagicMock()
+        mock_popen.return_value.communicate.return_value = (b'', b'')
+        mock_popen.return_value.returncode = 0
+        monkeypatch.setattr('subprocess.Popen', mock_popen)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(winrm, 'HAS_PEXPECT', False)
+
+        conn = connection_loader.get('winrm', PlayContext(), StringIO())
+        conn.set_options(var_options={'_extras': {},
+                                      'ansible_winrm_kinit_cmd': str(executable),
+                                      'ansible_winrm_kinit_args': '-r 7d'})
+        conn._build_winrm_kwargs()
+
+        conn._kerb_auth('user@domain', 'pass')
+        conn._kerb_auth('user@domain', 'pass')
+
+        assert mock_popen.call_count == 2
+        for call in mock_popen.call_args_list:
+            assert call[0][0] == [str(executable), '-r', '7d', 'user@domain']
+        first_cache = mock_popen.call_args_list[0][1]['env']['KRB5CCNAME']
+        second_cache = mock_popen.call_args_list[1][1]['env']['KRB5CCNAME']
+        assert first_cache.startswith('FILE:/')
+        assert second_cache.startswith('FILE:/')
+        assert first_cache != second_cache
+
     @pytest.mark.parametrize('options, expected', [

          ("kinit", ["user@domain"],)],

          ("kinit2", ["user@domain"],)],

+         ("/opt/CA/uxauth/bin/uxconsole", ["-krb", "-init", "user@domain"],)],
+        [{"_extras": {}, 'ansible_winrm_kinit_args': '-r 7d -f'},
+         ("kinit", ["-r", "7d", "-f", "user@domain"],)],
         [{"_extras": {'ansible_winrm_kerberos_delegation': True}},
          ("kinit", ["-f", "user@domain"],)],
+        [{"_extras": {'ansible_winrm_kerberos_delegation': True},
+          'ansible_winrm_kinit_args': '-r 7d'},
+         ("kinit", ["-r", "7d", "user@domain"],)],
+        [{"_extras": {'ansible_winrm_kerberos_delegation': True},
+          'ansible_winrm_kinit_args': ''},
+         ("kinit", ["user@domain"],)],
     ])
     def test_kinit_success_pexpect(self, monkeypatch, options, expected):
         pytest.importorskip("pexpect")
@@ -277,6 +325,7 @@ class TestWinRMKerbAuth(object):
 
         conn._kerb_auth("user@domain", "pass")
         mock_calls = mock_pexpect.mock_calls
+        assert len([call for call in mock_calls if call[0] == '']) == 1
         assert mock_calls[0][1] == expected
         actual_env = mock_calls[0][2]['env']
